# A loop over what a method returns, where the method reads a prop of its
# component -- itself, or through a method it calls inside a lambda -- and the
# component is spliced into one that hands the prop its own var. The slot
# re-renders on what its iterable reads, which reactivity learns of a call from
# the callee's Func.Reads, so it heard of neither: a prop is no var, and the
# splice put the caller's var into the method's body without adding it there
# (withSubstitutedReads); and a call inside a lambda in the method was not
# followed (gatherFuncReads). Either way, writing the caller's var re-rendered
# nothing and the card kept its old key.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func lookup(name string) async.Result[int] {
    return {ok=name.length()}
}

component card(name string) ui.node {
    var size option[int] = null
    async.query(on=name, fetch=lookup, :value=size)
    ui.text #len(value=size != null ? "{name} {size}" : name)
}

// Every fruit but the one chosen.
component others(chosen = "") ui.node {
    var all = ["blueberry", "fig"]

    func rest() list[string] {
        return all.filter(func(f string) => f != chosen)
    }

    for var n = rest() {
        card #c(name=n)
    }
}

// The same, the prop read by a method the lambda calls.
component besides(chosen = "") ui.node {
    var all = ["blueberry", "fig"]

    func picked() => chosen != "" ? chosen : "fig"

    func rest() list[string] {
        return all.filter(func(f string) => f != picked())
    }

    for var n = rest() {
        card #c(name=n)
    }
}

component pick ui.node {
    var chosen = "fig"

    others #o(chosen=chosen)
    ui.button #swap(text="Swap", @click { chosen = "blueberry" })
}

component pickAgain ui.node {
    var chosen = ""

    besides #o(chosen=chosen)
    ui.button #swap(text="Swap", @click { chosen = "blueberry" })
}

func testTheRestFollowsTheProp(t test.Test, c pick) {
    t.assert(c.o.c[0].len.value == "blueberry 9")
    c.swap.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.o.c[0].size == 3, 2000)
    t.assert(c.o.c[0].len.value == "fig 3")
}

func testTheRestFollowsAMethodTheLambdaCalls(t test.Test, c pickAgain) {
    t.assert(c.o.c[0].len.value == "blueberry 9")
    c.swap.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.o.c[0].size == 3, 2000)
    t.assert(c.o.c[0].len.value == "fig 3")
}

ui.window {
    pick()
    pickAgain()
}
